documented_probe: C-5ef2ad28 (combine values from reference clues to produce an expected payload): second independent covering task. The recipe is scattered across three artifact files (serial base, pricebook, movement ledger); the verifier executes the deliverable on hidden artifact directories and compares stdout to an independent reference derivation.
notes: Single-stage reconciliation: read a base value, a price table with comments/duplicates, and a movement ledger with a header, unknown labels and malformed rows, then combine them into a wrapped 5-digit payload. Rubric nonzero for reasoning_depth (three interacting formats + signed-mod wrapping), adversarial_inputs (messy rows, unknown labels, non-integer serial must fail cleanly) and quantitative_correctness (exact payload). Buckets to easy.
